description:
Page CRUD for individual pages and database rows.

Actions (required params -> optional):
- create (parent_id -> title, content, properties, icon, cover)
- get (page_id -> max_chars, content_limit, content_cursor): returns markdown bounded to max_chars (default 20000, max 100000) with an explicit [Truncated: showing N of M characters] marker; content_char_count and content_truncated report the true size, and bounded block reads also return next_cursor
- get_property (page_id, property_id)
- update (page_id -> title, content, append_content, properties, icon, cover, archived)
- move (page_id, parent_id)
- archive (page_id) / restore (page_id)
- duplicate (page_id -> parent_id)

Use `databases` instead for querying or bulk row operations. Property format: simple values auto-convert -- string for title/rich_text/select/status, number for number, boolean for checkbox, string[] for multi_select, ISO date "2025-01-15" for date. Example: properties: {"Name": "My Page", "Status": "In Progress", "Tags": ["urgent", "work"]}

content_cursor.description: Cursor from a previous bounded pages get

content_limit.description: Max page blocks to return for get; use next_cursor to continue

cover.description: Cover image: URL or built-in shorthand (gradient_1..11, solid_red/yellow/blue/beige, nasa_*, met_*, rijksmuseum_*, woodcuts_*)

full.description: Return the complete unbounded response (overrides max_chars and default item caps)

icon.description: Icon: emoji (e.g. "(icon)"), external URL (https://...), or built-in shorthand (name:color, e.g. "document:gray")

max_chars.description: Max markdown characters returned by get (1-100000, default 20000); truncated content ends with an explicit marker

page_ids.description: Multiple page IDs for batch operations

properties.description: Page properties (for database pages). Use simple values -- auto-converted to Notion format. String: title/rich_text/select/status. Number: number. Boolean: checkbox. String[]: multi_select. ISO date string: date. Object with Notion structure: pass through as-is.

name: pages
